marketing_description: The Makita LXT Series XNB07Z Brushless Cordless Framing Nailer eliminates the need for a compressor and hose while utilizing an 18V LXT Lithium-Ion battery to drive up to 750 nails per charge. This tool features a 30-degree strip magazine with a capacity of 84 nails ranging from 2 to 3-1/2 inches in length and offers selectable sequential or bump firing modes.
